5	from itertools import pairwise
6	
7	from mdata.types import Prices
8	from risk.types import Returns

11	def log_returns(prices: Prices) -> Returns:
12	    """r_t = ln(close_t / close_t-1), dated t (RISK-01).
13	
14	    Spine version: simple returns, r_t = close_t / close_t-1 - 1.
15	    Raises ValueError with fewer than two dates.
16	    """
17	    if len(prices.dates) < 2:
18	        raise ValueError(f"log_returns needs at least two dates, got {len(prices.dates)}")
19	    values = {
20	        ticker: tuple(current / previous - 1.0 for previous, current in pairwise(closes))
21	        for ticker, closes in prices.closes.items()
22	    }
23	    return Returns(
24	        base_date=prices.dates[0],
25	        dates=prices.dates[1:],
26	        tickers=prices.tickers,
27	        values=values,
28	    )
